title: This is how you build a thick lower back! 145 lbs (65 kg) barbell hyperextension
summary:
Video is muted because the song that was playing in the background is copyrighted worldwide. Sorry about the inconvenience. 
Barbell hypers are a great hypertrophy tool for your posterior chain (hammies, lower back, glutes). I do them with 25lbs plates and a snatch-grip to increase the range of motion which is already diminutive. This is also a great accessory lift for the conventional deadlift.
